haiku.problem: Verse 6 ('In the days to come, Jacob will take root...') is not attributed to the LORD in the BSB text. The question says 'what does the LORD say,' which misattributes the speaker.

The question calls the Assyrian group 'exiles from Assyria.' Verse 13 calls them 'those who were perishing in Assyria' and calls only the Egyptian group 'exiles.' The question also says 'come back' where the text says 'come forth.'
